description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gogo (V)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Deep Aqua Breath (0~2), removed after using Apex Deep Aqua Breath two times

description.name: Apex Deep Aqua Breath Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Deep Aqua Breath level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gogo (V)]

description.name: Apex Deep Aqua Breath Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Deep Aqua Breath level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gogo (V)]
